svg.title: Verran
svg.desc: North-up layout and numbered route key. 1. Lower Dock Steps. 2. Lower grain berth. 3. Counting Hall. 4. North Granary. 5. Ridge stair. 6. Washhouse Steps. 7. Ropewalk. 8. Hand-unloading stair.
svg.text: Harbor wards · deep berth, ridge and working shore
Small boats and the passenger gangway
Hoist over the loaded north ferry
Hearing table inside the loading door
Bonded grain above the flood line
Bench over the relief spur cover
Vats, sleeping room and closed branch
Kit’s sack line and ration landing
North up · Routes and footprints at blockout scale
